# Thinking Orbs SwiftUI sources

Vendored from [Libraries.dev](https://github.com/Jakubantalik/Libraries.dev/tree/f20116327f4e3b28d0fb70b04437dfd092bf88fe/packages/thinking-orbs/ports/ios/ThinkingOrbsKit/Sources/ThinkingOrbsKit)
at revision `f20116327f4e3b28d0fb70b04437dfd092bf88fe`. MIT license retained in LICENSE.

The Canvas reference is qualified as SwiftUI.Canvas to avoid the AppKit host’s Canvas class. The standalone snapshot utility is omitted.
Compiled directly by scripts/build-native.mjs; no React runtime or Metal shader.
ChatActivity.swift selects the inline 20-point presets and pauses hidden views.
